subject: WRITE statement
notes: 'The write file is the file referenced by file-name-1 or by the file-name associated with record-name-1.' (cite.py --check 14.9.51.3 OK, SR1). ResolveRecordName's identity test returns the FileModel whose Records contain the item (own files, then inherited GLOBAL FDs via FilesByName); that FileModel is the write file every later check (SR12/SR13/SR19/SR22, org reroute) and the BoundWrite/BoundKeyedWrite node use. The FILE file-name-1 arm is Annex A.4.13 declined (COBOL1706) so only the record-name arm is reachable. pb347_record_name_identity writes OUT-REC / OUT-REC OF OUTF and reads the records back from OUTF. [editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023 (base WRITE statement; the 2023 text records no change to this rule in Annex E)]
